name: Mathematical Sciences, Ph.D. / Combined Master's & Doctoral
department: College of Natural Sciences — Department of Mathematical Sciences

deadline.value: Fall 2027 International Admissions Guide has not yet been published by SNU Office of Admissions (Spring 2027 international online application ran July 6-9, 2026).

gre_subject.value: Central SNU Graduate Admissions Guide does not specify whether GRE Subject scores are expected or accepted for this program.

supervisor.value: Central SNU Graduate Admissions Guide and the department's English pages do not state whether pre-application supervisor contact is required.

funding.value: Competitive funding via university-wide international fellowships (GSFS: full tuition up to 4 semesters + >= KRW 500,000/mo; SPF for developing-country university faculty: full tuition up to 6 semesters + KRW 1.5M-2.0M/mo; GKS: full tuition + KRW 1.4M/mo) as well as BK21 Four Global EDGE Fellowship (KRW 1.8M/mo + full tuition) and faculty-grant RA/TA support.
funding.quote: SNU President Fellowship Program (SPF) | Tuition fee: full tuition exemption for a maximum of 6 semesters | Living expenses: 1, 500,000 KRW ~ 2,000,000 KRW per month for 3~4 years | Graduate Scholarship for Excellent Foreign Students (GSFS) | Tuition fee: full tuition exemption for a maximum of 4 semesters | Living expenses: minimum of 500,000 KRW per month (different according to recipients’ majors)

entry_route.value: Accepts both bachelor's holders (Combined Master's & Doctoral course) and master's holders (Doctoral program).
entry_route.quote: 1) Master’s / Combined Master’s & Doctoral Programs: a bachelor’s degree or higher | Combined Master’s and Doctoral Course is available to applicants who wish to obtain a Ph.D. degree without a master’s degree. Applicants must have a bachelor’s degree or higher and should apply for the Combined Master’s and Doctoral Course. | College of Mathematical Sciences ◯ ◯ ◯

notes: Research groups cover Algebra, Analysis, Topology, Geometry, and Applied Mathematics alongside the Research Institute of Mathematics. Note College of Education also offers a separate Mathematics Education (M/D) program.
